# ip.mlz.no

> Shows your public IPv4 or IPv6 address. Made by Martin Zachariassen (https://mlz.no).

## Usage

- [Plain-text endpoint](https://ip.mlz.no/ip): `GET /ip` returns the caller's address as plain text and is never cached. `HEAD` is also allowed; other methods return 405. Use https.
- [Web page](https://ip.mlz.no/): the same address in large type, click or press C to copy, R to copy as CIDR (/32 or /128).

Example: `curl https://ip.mlz.no/ip`
